# Reconcile the harness-simplification Task catalog

[Task index](index.md) · [Previous](./harness.simplification.control.successor-selection.md) · [Next](./harness.simplification.docs-json.md)

## Status

`superseded_by_task_graph_selection_state_decision`

## Objective

Reconcile every maintained harness-simplification proposal, deferred item, conceptual stage, and existing chain entry to one explicit durable catalog disposition without activating implementation or treating documentation as executable authority.

## Authorized scope

- Inspect the exact harness-simplification chain, its declared Task records, and maintained current or prospective harness pages that enumerate proposed, completed, deferred, rejected, or out-of-scope work.
- Create one deterministic project-local catalog in which each distinct documented work item has exactly one disposition: EXISTING_TASK, COMPLETED_BY, TASK_RECORD_REQUIRED, DEFERRED, REJECTED, or OUTSIDE_HARNESS_SCOPE.
- Record exact source references, current chain identity when present, prerequisite evidence, protected or human-owned boundaries, naming inconsistencies, duplicate concepts, and the reason for each disposition.
- Reconcile chain membership and explicit inactive dispositions only where the catalog deterministically demonstrates a missing or duplicate control entry; do not create executable successor contracts merely to populate the list.
- Obtain one consolidated independent read-only review of catalog completeness, disposition consistency, authority boundaries, chain reconciliation, and nonactivation.

## Completion criteria

- Every distinct item in the declared source pages and every chain entry appears exactly once in the catalog or has an explicit duplicate-of relation to its owning item.
- Every catalog entry has exactly one allowed disposition, exact source references, and an identified existing owner, completion owner, missing-record boundary, deferral authority, rejection authority, or scope boundary as applicable.
- The chain and catalog agree on identities, records, prerequisites, completed conceptual entries, inactive proposals, superseded entries, and any deterministically added inactive disposition entries.
- Legacy hyphenated and normalized dot-separated identities are reported without renaming completed or historical identities; any future identity migration requiring human choice remains unresolved rather than silently normalized.
- Focused schema, catalog, chain, projection, checkpoint, documentation, dependency-scope, and whitespace checks pass, and the independent review has no unresolved material finding.
- On completion this Task becomes completed, chain active_task returns to null, automatic successor activation remains false, and no implementation successor is activated.

## Exclusions

- Do not implement SQLite, persistence, migrations, event logs, execution records, package extraction, adapter removal, telemetry, publication, release, scientific work, external execution, or destructive retirement.
- Do not create, activate, prioritize, or assign an implementation Task solely because a proposal is documented or cataloged; TASK_RECORD_REQUIRED records a missing boundary rather than authorizing a new Task.
- Do not rewrite accepted historical Task identities, retained evidence, checkpoints, agent records, or completed decision records, and do not treat the catalog or documentation as human acceptance.
- Do not add dependencies, change lockfiles, perform Graphify, launch protected work, or activate review-dispatch-idempotency, evidence-and-sqlite, P3, publication, release, or any automatic successor.
